continuation.text:
I removed the Friday rule from `src/solution.py`, which was the only change. I didn't run or test the edited file.

The rule had two parts, and both are gone. One was the `FRIDAY_CUTOFF` constant. The other was the block in the slot loop that stopped Friday starts after 15:00 and required the meeting to end by 15:00. Fridays now follow the same rules as other weekdays: working hours 09:00–17:00, 15-minute increments, no starts during lunch, and no conflicts with events.

I left everything else as it was, including the weekend exclusion, the 15-minute buffer after events, and the duration validation, because you asked to avoid unrelated changes.
